# Item dressability

Retail/PTR `C_Item.IsDressableItemByID(itemInfo)` projects an explicit host-supplied per-item boolean. Its C API home is `src/c_api/item_spell/c_item.rs`; the historical test/spec checkpoint `13a818ba5` added no producer. After reached supplied-data/original-consumer RED in both profiles, native predicate source now authenticates the original argument, uses existing numeric/item-link identity parsing and projects only the explicit boolean map. GREEN remains pending. Profile-scoped native declarations establish a required `ItemInfo`, `AllowedWhenUntainted`, and one non-nil boolean result. Empty defaults and supplied classification are user-approved simulator policy, not a native item catalog claim.

## What it must do

### API and security

- [ ] Expose the Retail/PTR public API and return exactly one boolean for numeric identities and supported item links, including the existing generated hyperlink consumed by PlayerChoice.
- [ ] Reject absent/nil arguments and values outside the supported ItemInfo input types. Do not invent numeric range, coercion, item-name resolution, or malformed-string grammar contracts.
- [ ] Authenticate original VM secrets before parsing or lookup: untainted callers may query wrapped supported inputs; tainted callers must be denied wrapped inputs, including malformed/nil payloads. Ordinary inputs remain usable by tainted callers. Preserve wrapper identity and caller taint through denial and subsequent secure recovery.

### Approved host input

- [ ] Each environment starts with empty explicit per-item boolean records; an absent record yields false. Generated metadata, equipment/consumable sets, ownership and mount relations do not seed or infer this classification.
- [ ] Supplied true and supplied false project directly through numeric identity and corresponding supported item links. Neither projection requires a generated catalog entry, appearance record, or 3D model.
- [ ] Host insertion, replacement and removal are visible on the next query; removal restores the false miss. Inputs remain isolated between environments and do not mutate mount relations or equipment/consumable classification.

### Real consumer

- [ ] Preserve the whole profile-scoped cached PlayerChoice/ItemButton/SharedXML closure, original XML reward template, original ItemButton SetItem/GetItemInfo path and original IsDressupReward identity/provenance. Supplied classification must drive the original consumer without replacing globals or vendor methods.
- [ ] With the mount relation absent, supplier-controlled false/true/false classification for the existing real item yields the corresponding original consumer contrast. This asserts the supplied policy, not native Hearthstone dressability.
- [ ] Preserve independent supplied mount-relation behavior: false dressability must not suppress a mapped mount; changing the mount relation must not change the direct dressability projection.

## How it works

- [Lua/C API integration](../lua-api.md).
- [Independent mount relation contract](mount-item-relations.md).

## Implementation inventory

- `src/c_api/item_spell/c_item.rs` — Retail/PTR-only native predicate publication, original-VM-secret authentication, required numeric/string input validation, existing identity parser and explicit map lookup with false miss.
- `src/c_api/item_spell/helpers.rs` — existing metadata projections; not authoritative dressability inputs.
- `src/lua_api/state/sim_state.rs` / `src/lua_api/state.rs` — uniform empty `item_dressability: HashMap<u32, bool>` storage; query publication is decided once at C_Item registration for Retail/PTR. Uniform storage avoids repeated profile cfg lists; it does not publish or seed an earlier-profile API.
- `tests/item_dressability.rs` — five authored API/input cases; initial two-case RED checkpoint below. Public lookup, not raw registration-table shape, is the contract.
- `tests/mount_item_player_choice.rs` — unchanged whole cached consumer helper plus authored supplied false/true/false and independent mount contrast; execution pending.

## Tests asserting this spec

Initial `13a818ba5` tests contained exactly two cases:

- `item_dressability_empty_input_returns_exactly_one_boolean_false` — numeric ID and supported bare/generated item-link defaults, type and arity.
- `item_dressability_requires_item_info_and_authenticates_vm_secrets` — required argument/type rejection, authentic wrapped numeric/link queries, malformed wrapped payloads, tainted denial and secure recovery.

Initial PTR API RED at `13a818ba5` executed two cases: 0 PASS / 2 FAIL, exit101, independently classified with successful environment initialization. First numeric miss passed exact-one-return arity then failed `empty supplied classification must return boolean false`; actual value/type was not printed. First no-argument call failed the combined rejection/string-message assertion `required ItemInfo must reject input`; successful return versus non-string error is not distinguished by output. Later selectors and all secret/taint assertions were unreached. Retail at source `c7ba479fe` subsequently executed the same 0 PASS / 2 FAIL, exit101 and first assertion messages; independently classified as reached API behavior RED after successful environment initialization, with the same first-failure limits and unreached security assertions. No passing contract checkboxes or modeled/native consumer coverage follow from initial RED.

The input-only successor authors three additional direct cases for supplied numeric/bare/generated-link booleans and uncatalogued identity, replacement/removal/isolation, and independent mount/equipment/consumable inputs. The security case now exercises supplied false and true. One added original PlayerChoice case preserves whole closure/template/method provenance and supplies false/true/false plus independent mount controls. Retail at `76e8b8309` now executed direct 0 PASS / 5 FAIL and unchanged whole cached PlayerChoice 0 PASS / 1 FAIL, each exit101. Direct supplied queries fail nonboolean results; the consumer preserves original methods/SetItem/link/provenance, accepts supplied-false baseline then returns false for supplied true. Independent Retail classification confirms five direct feature REDs plus the original-consumer feature RED. PTR at `733399c38` subsequently executed the same direct 0 PASS / 5 FAIL and original-consumer 0 PASS / 1 FAIL, each exit101; direct nonboolean/required-input and original false-versus-supplied-true boundaries retained. Independent PTR classification confirms five direct feature REDs plus the original-consumer feature RED; later secret/state/mount controls remain unreached. Native predicate source follows those reached REDs; GREEN remains pending.

[Initial selected packet](../../data/patch-api/evidence/bullet-dress-initial-api-red-2026-10-13/README.md) retains whole Retail/PTR initial API streams and independent classification; corrected bounded public-copy/privacy/link gate PASS at `a7439281a`, original invocation-ID privacy FAIL retained.

### Verified bounded runtime — 2026-10-13

Retail and PTR each pass five explicit-boolean/input/security/isolation cases and the original PlayerChoice dressability/mount contrast. These prove the supplied model, not native item classification.

The [whole host-record packet](../../data/patch-api/evidence/bullet-dress-host-records-2026-10-13/README.md) owns the mixed-revision matrix, preservation, complete diagnostics, startup and check/format evidence. Public-copy acceptance is pending; native/render parity, earlier profiles and the parent handoff remain open.

## Known gaps (current cycle)

- [x] Independently classify initial Retail RED; both profiles executed before passive input changes. Classification does not establish passing API, supplied-record, security or consumer coverage.
- [x] Execute reached host-state RED on Retail/PTR before predicate source; later state/link/security assertions remain unreached at that checkpoint.
- [ ] Execute complete GREEN for explicit true/false, uncatalogued/link identity, replacement/removal/isolation and independent mount/equipment/consumable state.
- [x] Execute real-consumer supplied-true RED on both profiles through unchanged whole closure/methods/link path, before predicate source. No sliced/recreated/mocked consumer.
- [x] Independently classify PTR supplied-input and original-consumer RED; no GREEN or later mount-control proof.
- [ ] Execute original-consumer GREEN and later mount controls.
- [ ] Verify committed producer source, mapped-secret behavior, earlier-profile preservation and broader acceptance; integration remains main-owned.

## Out of scope

Native catalog/classification, ownership or transmog eligibility inference and 3D rendering: not authorized or established by declarations. No inference from Hearthstone metadata, inventory type, equipment sets or mount membership. Numeric-domain/coercion/name grammar and malformed-string outcomes are not specified by this bounded declaration evidence. Historical input-only successor added passive storage/tests; current predicate follows actual RED with no catalog or metadata alternative path. Native classification, 3D and broader acceptance remain separate gaps.

# Supplied BulletTextList visualization

BulletTextList type10 belongs to the `src/c_api/ui_widget_manager/` supplied-state subsystem; the [widget manager wiki](../wiki/systems/ui-widget-manager-state.md) owns how records, cached consumers and events work. Contract sources are the active Retail/PTR caches under `~/.cache/wow-ui-sim/blizzard-ui/<profile>/AddOns/`: `Blizzard_APIDocumentationGenerated/UIWidgetManagerDocumentation.lua` declares the getter and fifteen fields; `Blizzard_UIWidgets/Blizzard_UIWidgetTemplateBulletTextList.lua` registers type10 and consumes pooled lines. These are cached declarations/consumer source, not native runtime proof. The original `3bd83b432` checkpoint added tests/spec only. The historical input-only successor added a complete passive DTO, empty environment-owned map, type10 host feed and authored supplied-data/cached-consumer tests. After reached Retail/PTR supplied-record/callback/unchanged-cache RED, the getter now projects complete fresh rows and ordered fresh lines through the existing numeric/secret boundary. GREEN remains unexecuted; empty backing is simulator policy, not a native catalog.

## What it must do

### Public query and supplied-state policy

- [ ] Retail/PTR public `C_UIWidgetManager.GetBulletTextListWidgetVisualizationInfo(widgetID)` rejects supplied nil, string, bool and table selectors with contextual `C_UIWidgetManager.GetBulletTextListWidgetVisualizationInfo: widgetID must be a number` error text. A failure merely caused by an absent function is not successful validation.
- [ ] Follow existing numeric `WidgetId` lookup policy without truncation, coercion or a new native ID-range rule. Empty-by-default supplied backing and unknown numeric IDs return exactly one nil. **Simulator arity/default policy**, not native proof; cached declarations establish a nullable result, not observed native unknown-ID behavior.
- [ ] Preserve existing numeric `AllowedWhenUntainted` policy: real host-secret NUMBER selectors are accepted when untainted and denied before present/absent lookup when tainted. Both cached getter declarations explicitly say `SecretArguments = "AllowedWhenUntainted"`; actual BulletTextList execution remains unproved. Do not invent a new secrecy policy.

### Complete fifteen-field snapshots

Both cached structures declare every field non-nil. Preserve supplied values and declared Lua types without synthesizing defaults or consumer clamping. Enum declarations establish field types, not native admissibility of arbitrary enum values.

- [ ] `shownState`: preserve supplied `WidgetShownState` numeric value.
- [ ] `enabledState`: preserve supplied `WidgetEnabledState` numeric value.
- [ ] `lines`: return a fresh ordered, dense one-based array of supplied strings, preserving order, empty strings and an empty list.
- [ ] `widgetSizeSetting`: preserve supplied number.
- [ ] `textureKit`: preserve supplied texture-kit string.
- [ ] `frameTextureKit`: preserve supplied texture-kit string.
- [ ] `hasTimer`: preserve supplied bool.
- [ ] `orderIndex`: preserve supplied number.
- [ ] `widgetTag`: preserve supplied string.
- [ ] `inAnimType`: preserve supplied `WidgetAnimationType` numeric value.
- [ ] `outAnimType`: preserve supplied `WidgetAnimationType` numeric value.
- [ ] `widgetScale`: preserve supplied `UIWidgetScale` numeric value.
- [ ] `layoutDirection`: preserve supplied `UIWidgetLayoutDirection` numeric value.
- [ ] `modelSceneLayer`: preserve supplied `UIWidgetModelSceneLayer` numeric value.
- [ ] `scriptedAnimationEffectID`: preserve supplied number.

### Freshness, isolation and feed ordering

- [ ] Every present-record query returns a fresh row and fresh `lines` table. Caller mutations to either cannot change host input, later queries or retained snapshots.
- [ ] Clone supplied records so replacement/deletion cannot alter retained rows or lines. Identical IDs in separate `WowLuaEnv` instances remain independent; no normal demo seeds are added.
- [ ] Extend the existing typed host feed for type10 only after genuine public-API RED. Validate supplied-set existence and entry/visualization type before mutation or notification; rejection leaves state/events unchanged.
- [ ] Store complete visualization and membership before synchronous `UPDATE_UI_WIDGET`; real event callbacks must observe updated data through the public getter. Membership removal reconciles through existing `UPDATE_ALL_UI_WIDGETS` ordering while independent visualization remains queryable, following [existing supplied-state policy](ui-widget-manager-state.md).

### Real cached pooled-line consumer

These requirements are driven by unchanged Retail/PTR cached source, not evidence that simulator execution already works.

- [ ] Activate type10 through the real cached manager and `UIWidgetContainerTemplate`, not a fake consumer or replacement global. Actual template `OnLoad` creates its line pool; `Setup` displays supplied strings in order and propagates enabled state to Bullet/Text.
- [ ] Incremental supplied updates run actual cached `Setup`: old active lines are released, new ordered lines acquired, stale lines removed, and visible text/enabled state updated. Observe real pool/count/frame behavior after actual OnUpdate flushing where required.
- [ ] Hidden visualization is suppressed by the cached type10 query adapter; visible restoration reactivates it through real manager reconciliation.
- [ ] Membership removal releases the active widget and pooled lines through real cached reset/removal behavior; retained query snapshots remain unchanged. Assert committed-state event ordering before downstream consumer outcomes.

## How it works

- [Widget manager architecture](../wiki/systems/ui-widget-manager-state.md)
- [Existing supplied-state/feed contract](ui-widget-manager-state.md)
- [Event dispatch](../event-system.md)
- [Cached addon loading](../addon-loading-pipeline.md)

## Implementation inventory

- `tests/ui_widget_bullet_text_list_api_red.rs`: two Retail/PTR-only public-API cases using real `WowLuaEnv::new`/`eval`; no host producer, stubs, mocks or replaced globals.
- `src/c_api/ui_widget_manager/bullet.rs` / `queries.rs`: Retail/PTR native getter registration, existing numeric/secret validation, cloned host input and rooted fresh row/line-array projection.
- `src/c_api/ui_widget_manager/bullet_record.rs` and `inputs.rs`: complete fifteen-field `BulletTextListRecord` and empty `bullet_text_lists` map; no default DTO, filler or seeds.
- `src/c_api/ui_widget_manager/feed.rs`: `WidgetVisualization::BulletTextList`, type10 and existing state-before-event update path. Callback outcome is unproved at the source stage.
- `tests/ui_widget_manager_bullet_text_list.rs` / `tests/widget_bullet/`: seven authored supplied-record, snapshot/lifetime/numeric-key/security/feed and unchanged cached pooled-line lifecycle cases.
- Cached Retail/PTR API documentation and BulletTextList Lua/XML templates: external declaration/consumer owners, unchanged.

## Tests asserting this spec

`tests/ui_widget_bullet_text_list_api_red.rs` contains exactly two cases, under `cfg(any(feature = "client-retail", feature = "client-ptr"))`:

1. `bullet_text_list_public_api_rejects_non_numeric_widget_id_with_context`: supplied nil/string/bool/table calls must reject at the contextual widgetID-number boundary. First observable assertion is public validation, before cache loading, host input or consumer prerequisites. Missing-function errors cannot satisfy the required message.
2. `bullet_text_list_empty_default_unknown_numeric_id_returns_one_nil_simulator_policy`: unknown numeric IDs must return exactly one nil in an untouched environment. Explicit simulator arity/default policy, not native proof.

Helper follows existing TextWithState/Discrete phase-tagged Lua error capture, historically using `eval::<()>`; `bde7ea277` corrects this statement-script helper to use `exec`. No source-substring or raw-registration assertions. Compilation and execution were unrun at the original test/spec checkpoint `3bd83b432`. Initial API RED is now independently classified for Retail at that source and PTR at `13a818ba5`: each executed two cases, 1 PASS / 1 FAIL, exit101. Empty unknown numeric one-nil policy passed; supplied nil was accepted, failing `nil: expected widgetID validation error`. String/bool/table and subsequent message checks were unreached. This proves the initial validation/default boundary only; fields, freshness, real-secret policy, feed and cached consumer have no new behavioral proof.

[Initial PTR selected packet](../../data/patch-api/evidence/bullet-dress-initial-api-red-2026-10-13/README.md) retains whole initial API streams and independent classification; corrected bounded public-copy/privacy/link gate PASS at `a7439281a`, original invocation-ID privacy FAIL retained. Earlier Retail Bullet RED is separately recorded above, not duplicated by that packet.

### Passive supplied-record tests

Seven successor cases were authored at `76e8b8309`: three query cases cover all fifteen fields, ordered fresh lines, replacement/deletion/isolation and existing numeric identity; one real VM-secret case covers untainted/tainted present/absent lookup; two feed cases cover committed-data callbacks and atomic rejection; one cached lifecycle case loads the unchanged closure/container and observes lines through their anchor chain, enabled-state FontStrings, replacement/hide/restore/removal/unregister. Missing prerequisites are setup failures, not result-boundary RED. First intended consumer-data assertion is inside a real event callback; no globals or vendor methods are replaced.

Retail at `76e8b8309` now executed 0 PASS / 7 FAIL, exit101, after a separate 4GiB admission denial (zero launch) and fresh 2GiB admission. Six failures reach missing supplied data through queries or real feed/cached-consumer callbacks; the rejection case instead fails a wrong `sets.is_empty()` fixture assumption because existing demo sets are seeded. That case is not getter RED. Its source oracle now compares complete pre/post set state for both rejection paths, preserving existing seeds; corrected execution remains pending. Child-reexec summary is the same consumer, not an eighth case. Independent Retail classification confirms six feature REDs plus one fixture-assumption failure. PTR at `733399c38` also executed 0 PASS / 7 FAIL, exit101: same missing-data/callback and old fixture boundaries; independent PTR classification confirms six feature REDs plus one fixture-oracle failure, without reclassifying the historical run or proving the corrected full-baseline oracle. Security and pooled-line lifecycle assertions remain unreached. Getter source follows these reached RED boundaries; GREEN is pending.

### Verified bounded runtime — 2026-10-13

Retail and PTR each pass seven supplied-record/query/security/cached-consumer cases, plus the two original public-API cases. `bde7ea277` corrects the test helper to execute statement chunks with `exec`; historical fixture failures remain retained.

The [whole host-record packet](../../data/patch-api/evidence/bullet-dress-host-records-2026-10-13/README.md) owns the mixed-revision matrix, complete diagnostics, startup and check/format evidence. Public-copy acceptance is pending; native/render parity, earlier profiles and the parent handoff remain open.

## Known gaps (current cycle)

- [x] Initial Retail/PTR API RED executed before production edits: each 1 PASS / 1 FAIL, exit101, independently classified; exact boundary above.
- [x] Add passive complete DTO/empty backing/type10 feed and authored supplied-record/security/real cached lifecycle tests after initial API RED; source only, not runtime acceptance.
- [x] Execute reached supplied-record/callback/unchanged-cache RED on both profiles with getter unchanged, then add complete getter source; historical fixture failure stays separate.
- [x] Independently classify PTR supplied-record/callback RED and the separate original fixture-oracle failure.
- [ ] Execute corrected full-baseline rejection oracle and field/security/cached-lifecycle GREEN.
- [ ] Establish field/freshness/isolation/security/feed and real cached pooled-line lifecycle proof; authored successor tests do not establish it.
- [ ] Establish bounded GREEN and integration proof separately; no native/render/full-widget acceptance follows from cached declarations or this test-stage source.

## Out of scope

Other widget types, vendor/cache/Wowless modifications, new normal/demo seeds and new transport are excluded from this slice. Native catalogs, native unknown-ID arity, native enum admissibility, native event/allocation/lifetime parity, rendered/pixel parity and full widget-system acceptance remain unproved. Historical passive stage excluded getter implementation until supplied-record/consumer RED; current producer follows those actual failures without broader acceptance. No build/integration harness changes, new transport or vendor modification is needed.

# UI Widget Manager State

Environment-local supplied UI widget sets, visualization snapshots, exact quest associations and synchronous host feeds form the core model. Production `0745fe84f` adds supplied bars and HUD selectors. The [contract](../../specs/ui-widget-manager-state.md) owns requirements; the [retained attempts](../../../data/patch-api/evidence/ui-widget-manager-state-2026-10-13/README.md#later-consumer-attempts) own current outcomes and historical failures. Historical test-only `b28a45f91` has HUD OnLoad2 PASS and bar initial visibility FAIL; later `5bd208dba` closes the bounded Retail consumer assertions below. No native or whole-goal acceptance follows.

## State and representation

`UiWidgetInputs` stores set records keyed by `WidgetId`, independent IconAndText records, and exact `(questID, setType)` associations. A set contains layout direction, vertical padding, and an ordered vector of explicit widget IDs, types, and optional unit tokens. Numeric keys preserve floating-point bits except equal signed zeroes; availability is not inferred from ID ranges.

Queries project fresh Lua tables from supplied state: unknown set metadata and IconAndText records return nil; unknown membership returns an empty table. IconAndText projects the complete supplied record, including tooltip, texture kits, timer, ordering, animation, scale, layout, and model-layer fields, without automatic field fillers. Existing complete ButtonHeader and Prey records remain separate backing inputs; core feeds support IconAndText type0, ButtonHeader type30, and feature-gated PreyHuntProgress type31. New feed integration adds `WidgetVisualization` StatusBar type2 and CaptureBar type1. This is not coverage of every visualization type.

A C_API widget record is data, **not a Rust `Frame`**. Blizzard's cached Lua manager consumes that data and owns actual template selection, frame pools, activation, updates, and removal. Resulting ordinary frames participate in the existing [widget architecture](../../widget-system.md), [loading pipeline](../../addon-loading-pipeline.md), and [event dispatch](../../event-system.md). The producer does not replace the manager with Rust-rendered widget consumers.

## Exact demo associations

Initialization preserves the existing twelve demo world quests: three explicitly stored set types per quest (Tooltip, BehindIcon, AdventureMapDetails), totaling 36 sets and associations. The initializer derives the previous fixture IDs and supplies one IconAndText member per set with the `Worldquest` texture kit. Query-time lookup uses stored associations, not numeric thresholds or synthesized ranges. These are demo fixtures, not a native quest/widget catalog.

## Synchronous host feeds

`WowLuaEnv` exposes three source-implemented operations:

- `replace_ui_widget_set`: replace or remove a set, then synchronously publish `UPDATE_ALL_UI_WIDGETS`; independent visualization records survive.
- `update_ui_widget`: validate type and supplied-set existence, update an existing membership in place or append a new member, store the visualization, then synchronously publish `UPDATE_UI_WIDGET` with supplied identity/type/unit-token fields. Type mismatches and unknown sets fail before mutation or notification.
- `remove_ui_widget`: remove matching membership and publish `UPDATE_ALL_UI_WIDGETS` only when membership changed; return false for absent sets/members. Visualization snapshots remain independently queryable.

State is committed before notification. Full reconciliation and incremental consumer behavior belong to the cached Blizzard manager; source wiring alone does not prove their runtime lifecycle.

The [contract proof ledger](../../specs/ui-widget-manager-state.md#tests-asserting-this-spec) retains historical query, cached-container, security, deferred-layout, and unit-notification failures.
